label: AB7C12_mC40_8_a_3a2b_4a4b-001
title: Monoclinic BiMn$_{7}$O$_{12}$ Structure
comments:
As with all rare-earth quadruple perovskite manganites ({\em R}Mn$_{7}$O$_{12}$) undergoes a series of phase transitions with increasing temperature (Behr, 2023): \begin{itemize} \item Below 290K it is in a \href{current_web_home_dir/AB7C12_aP20_1_a_7a_12a-001}{triclinic BiMn$_{7}$O$_{12}$} structure. \item Between 290 and 460K it is in this \href{current_web_home_dir/AB7C12_mC40_8_a_3a2b_4a4b-001}{monoclinic BiMn$_{7}$O$_{12}$} structure. \item Between 460 and 608K it is in the \href{current_web_home_dir/A7B12C_mC40_12_abcef_2i2j_d-001}{monoclinic PrMn$_{7}$O$_{12}$} structure. \item Above 608K it is in the parent \href{current_web_home_dir/A7BC12_cI40_204_bc_a_g-001}{cubic NaMn$_{7}$O$_{12}$} structure. \end{itemize} ~ \vspace{-.25in} 
 (Mezzadri, 2009) present this structure in the body-centered $Im$ setting of space group \#8, with a nearly cubic conventional cell.  We converted this to the AFLOW standard $Cm$ setting.  This involves a rearrangement of the primitive vectors so that the conventional unit cell is no longer cubic.
